title: Regression Guardian
noData: Drop APM incident payloads (JSON) in .workpilot/incidents/, then run the analysis.

errors.noProject: Select a project to run the Regression Guardian scan.

description: Turns the incidents saved in .workpilot/incidents/ (Sentry, Datadog, CloudWatch…) into skeleton regression tests in the framework of the failing stack.
automationHint: To turn each new incident into a bug-fix card (the failing regression test first, then the fix, in the card's branch and PR), add a « production incident » rule in Settings › project › Automations. It reads this folder and, if you name one, a Sentry project.
